scope_limit: Added pathway_membership.run to reconstruct actual native CNV membership from original GMT and GENCODE. The original coding-preferred, exact-case, many-to-many mapping is reused; the legacy standalone builder remains unchanged in behavior. The new native output preserves every unmatched source symbol in an explicit unavailable namespace instead of discarding it. Both original CNV consumers enforce matching annotation bytes and named GMT collection hashes against their actual candidates, record mapping coverage and retain original unique-gene signed/absolute estimands and event-or-all-members callability. Both actual model-use inspectors follow the membership back to GMT/GTF without inventing study or patient identities. The four-stage reference/interval/membership/expression chain resumes immutably; registry has 33 operations. Reference acquisition/authenticity, other membership consumers, remaining source/patient coverage and full external acceptance remain open. Only synthetic inputs, actual original R/CNV computation and explicitly frozen core-export serialization were exercised; no learned fitting, real-cohort processing, downloads, paid compute or deployment ran.
